posts.text:
Back in 1989, I walked this very stage. Rangers, today it’s your turn.
 
Show up, be kind, and build strong communities wherever you go. Your job is just to take the detours and enjoy the journey. You don’t have to know where you’re going… and that’s the best part.

Anti-abortion extremists will continue their nationwide assault on abortion and all forms of reproductive health care.

Every Michigander deserves the freedom to make their own decisions about their bodies, lives, and futures. I’ll keep fighting like hell to protect that freedom.

Today, the Supreme Court confirmed that mifepristone—a safe, effective, FDA-approved drug—can continue to be accessed nationwide through telehealth. While this is the right decision, it’s not the end of this fight.

Women’s Health Week is a chance to show what Michigan can achieve when we work together. We’ve expanded access to care, protected reproductive freedom, and strengthened support for families. I’m proud of how far we’ve come and I’m committed to building a healthier future.

No one should have to choose between paying the bills or getting the care they need. 
 
That’s why I:

✅Signed key parts of the ACA into Michigan law.
✅Made sure mental health is covered by law.
✅Passed a budget that protects the 2.5 million Michiganders who rely on Medicaid.

Video

I'm backing efforts in Congress to ban Chinese vehicles. Right now, government-subsidized Chinese vehicles are being dumped in other countries, leading to plant closures and layoffs. We must do more to bolster and protect U.S. manufacturing. wilx.com/2026/05/12/whitmer-…
It's always great to be in Macomb! This community knows how to show up, work hard, and take care of the basics that keep families strong.

Two weeks is too long for businesses, schools, and families to go without water.

I'm hopeful GLWA, Oakland County, and contractors can speed up that timeline to restore service.

We will get through this together.

Yesterday, six Oakland County communities faced a waterline rupture that led to losses of service and boil-water advisories.

I declared a state of emergency to support impacted communities, help restore water service, and ensure Michiganders have access to safe drinking water.

Video

Thinking of my mom today and all the incredible mothers across Michigan. Happy Mother’s Day.

Video
I appreciate the swift response from emergency personnel, local officials, and utility crews actively working to address this situation.

We are activating all available state resources to help support impacted communities in Oakland County, restore water service as quickly as possible, and ensure Michiganders have access to safe drinking water.

The skilled trades really do have it all: big machines, serious skills, and hard-working people who know how to get things done.

Video

When our kids can count on free breakfast and lunch, they show up ready to learn.

It’s helping all 1.4 million students stay focused and prepared every day and it’s time to make it permanent.

Looking for a path to a good-paying job?
✨Michigan Reconnect is here for you ✨ 

Michiganders 25 and up can earn an associate’s degree or skills certificate… tuition-free! Let's help more Michiganders jump start the career of their dreams and expand Reconnect to 21 and up.

Hockeytown, it’s finally happening! 🏒 
Young women who play hockey in arenas and backyards across the state will know they can follow their dreams right here in Detroit and join the incredible Michigan talent already taking the ice across the league.


PWHL Detroit (@pwhl__detroit)

MOTOR CITY STAND UP 🗣️

The PWHL is coming BACK to Detroit – permanently. ​
 ➡️ detroitpwhl.com





— https://nitter.net/pwhl__detroit/status/2052033661399179471#m
If you ever have any information on a missing or murdered Indigenous person in Michigan, please contact the MMIP Task Force Tipline to report anonymously at 517-284-0008.

We have a responsibility to protect and deliver justice for Indigenous communities in Michigan. I remain committed to working with Michigan’s Tribal Nations to prevent further violence against Indigenous people.

We can create a Michigan where no one has to live in fear.

Video

Happy Teacher Appreciation Week! 🍎
In Michigan, we’re home to some of the best educators around, from kindergarten classrooms to college campuses. Every day, you help shape the next generation of leaders and make our state stronger.

Thank you for all that you do.
We will keep fighting like hell in Michigan to protect people’s fundamental freedom to make their own decisions about their own bodies.
